payload.summary: visualjc idea during sports-betting-markets onboarding: 'nahel install --agent claude' should also create CLAUDE.md with first line '@AGENTS.md' so Claude Code imports the agent-neutral instructions. Design: create-if-absent ONLY (existing CLAUDE.md is user content — never edit; print a hint if the @AGENTS.md reference is missing, same restraint as the skills-symlink refusal). Lives in install's claude target, not init. Note: some harnesses now read AGENTS.md natively; the one-line shim is still worth it for coverage.
